kicker: How to solve a Bible cryptogram
steps: Fill in the starter letters first
Write each given letter everywhere it appears. Two or three letters can open up a whole verse.
A lone letter is almost always A or I, which gives you another letter for free.
THE, AND, OF, HE and LORD turn up again and again in the King James Bible.
Each cryptogram is labelled with its verse. Stuck? Open your Bible and check one word.

steps: Q, Z, X and J stand out in a grid. If a word has one, look for it first.

Pairs like LL, SS or EE are easy to spot, as in GALILEE or JESSE.
Slide a pencil along each row
It keeps your place and rests your eyes.
